risks.title: Ongoing Transformation and Regulatory Compliance
risks.score_rationale: Major risk positioned at the beginning of Item 1A (pages 49-62). Intensive language: explicit mention of the 2020 Consent Order and its July 2024 amendment recently terminated in December 2025. Trend: stable but demanding (80% of transformation programs achieved). Category weight: banking regulation critical for Citigroup.

risks.title: Geopolitical and Country Risks (Russia, Mexico)
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly addressed in Item 1A and Recent Developments (pages 11, 49-62). Intensive language: $1.2 billion loss on AO Citibank Russia sale (February 2026), goodwill impairment of $726M on Banamex Mexico. Trend: up (materialization of risks). Category weight: direct impact on revenue and capital.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and Systemic Information Technology Risks
risks.score_rationale: Dedicated risk Item 1C (pages 55-57, 113-115). Intensive language: specific cybersecurity section in the 10-K. Trend: up (increasing technology and transformation investments). Category weight: critical for global financial institution operating across 160 jurisdictions.

risks.title: Intense Competition in Global Financial Services
risks.score_rationale: Implicit risk in Item 1A (pages 49-62) and stated strategy. Moderate language but clear context: Citi aims to be 'preeminent banking partner for institutions with cross-border needs' and 'global leader in wealth management'. Trend: stable (consistent strategic positioning). Category weight: determinant for revenue and market share.

risks.title: Dependence on Treasury Revenues and Market Volatility
risks.score_rationale: Structural risk in Item 1A and MD&A (pages 8-36, 64-120). Moderate language: non-interest revenue down 4% in 2025 (declines in Markets, All Other, USPB). Trend: down (compression of market revenues). Category weight: Markets represents major revenue segment.

risks.title: Credit Risk and Portfolio Quality Deterioration
risks.score_rationale: Explicit risk in Item 1A and Credit Risk (pages 49-62, 64-120). Moderate language: credit loss provisions of $10.3 billion in 2025 (vs $10.1B in 2024), net credit losses up 1%. Trend: stable (provisions stable but increasing slightly). Category weight: credit critical for universal bank.

risks.title: Compliance Risks and Multiple Regulatory Litigation
risks.score_rationale: Risk addressed in Item 3 (Legal Proceedings, pages 287-293) and Item 1A. Moderate language but serious context: multiple litigations and ongoing regulatory proceedings. Trend: stable (chronic industry litigations). Category weight: potential impact on capital and reputation.

risks.title: Dependence on Client Deposits and Deposit Flight Risk
risks.score_rationale: Structural risk in Item 1A and Liquidity Risk (pages 49-62, 64-120). Moderate language: average deposits of $1.4 trillion up 4%, but critical dependence on stable deposits. Trend: stable (deposit growth in 2025). Category weight: deposits essential for funding and NII.
